title: 第9章 比武大会圣子之位第10章 藏经阁超然奥秘
slug: 亿倍返还双手插兜没有对手
lines: 时光悠悠而过，三天时间转眼过去。
这一天，苏长歌缓缓睁开双眼。
瞳孔中迸发出一道红色精光，一闪即逝，极为锋利，像是眼中蕴含着一把剑。
此刻，他浑身上上下下、所有的微小角落里的真气，已经全被玉葫灵髓转变为血红色真气！
带来的增益极大，他感到自己浑身上下都充满了雄厚的力量，浑身筋骨噼啪作响，发出如龙如虎般的咆哮声！
他站起来，一股雄厚的真气顿时从他体内爆发，伴随着蜕凡境的威压，横扫四方！
周围的桌椅板凳当场炸开，迸溅成无数碎片！
苏长歌心头大喜！
若是让那些核心弟子知道他体内所有的真气，都已经蜕变为血红色真气，那还不得陷入深深的自我怀疑中！
那些核心弟子，无一不是心高气傲之辈。
要知道，能走到核心那一步的，都是弟子中的佼佼者！
太玄道宗弟子的品级很简单。
共分为杂役、外门、内门、核心、真传。
再往上就是圣子。
不过圣子到现在还没立，原因是没有合适的人选。
而苏长歌在宗门中的地位，几乎是没有地位。
因为梨花峰就他一个弟子，自然没办法分品级。
苏长歌取出一把剑，走了出去。
他要试试御剑飞行。
这是他前世的梦想，御剑飞行，多么潇洒！
来到门外，他直接祭出这把剑，随后脚踏上去，尝试着运转体内的力量。
只听“嗖”
的一声，一股浩瀚的力量传递到剑上，长剑当即带着他，冲天而起。
三十米！
五十米！
一百米！
一千米！
两千米！
很快，苏长歌便飞到两千米高空！
他低头看着下方越来越小的宗门山峰，再看着远处的人流，不由得心情大好，畅快无比的大喝道：“好！
好！
content_en:
Time passed by slowly, and three days passed in the blink of an eye.
On this day, Su Changge slowly opened his eyes.
A red light burst out from the pupils, which was fleeting and extremely sharp, as if there was a sword in the eyes.
At this moment, all the infuriating energy in every tiny corner of his body has been transformed into blood-red infuriating energy by the jade gourd spirit marrow!
The gain brought about was huge. He felt that his whole body was filled with strong strength, and his muscles and bones crackled, making a roar like a dragon or a tiger!
"Boom!"
He stood up, and a strong burst of true energy suddenly burst out from his body, along with the pressure of the Mortal Transformation Realm, sweeping across all directions!
The surrounding tables, chairs and benches exploded on the spot, splattering into countless pieces!
"Strong!"
Su Changge was overjoyed!
If those core disciples knew that all the Qi in his body had transformed into blood-red Qi, they would not be able to fall into deep self-doubt!
Those core disciples are all arrogant people.
You know, those who can reach the core are the best among the disciples!
The grades of disciples of Taixuan Dao Sect are very simple.
It is divided into handymen, outer sect, inner sect, core and true inheritance.
Further up is the Son.
However, the Holy Son has not yet been established because there is no suitable candidate.
Su Changge's status in the sect was almost non-existent.
Since he was the only disciple at Lihuafeng, there was no way to grade him.
Su Changge took out a sword and walked out.
He wanted to try sword flying.
This was his dream in his previous life, flying with a sword, how cool and unrestrained!
When he came outside the door, he directly offered the sword, then stepped on it and tried to use the power in his body.
Just listen to "whoosh"
With a sound, a vast force was transmitted to the sword, and the sword immediately took him into the sky.
Thirty meters!
Fifty meters!
One hundred meters!
…
One thousand meters!
Two thousand meters!
Soon, Su Changge flew to an altitude of two thousand meters!
He looked down at the increasingly smaller sect peaks below, and then at the flow of people in the distance. He couldn't help but feel very good, and shouted happily: "Okay!
OK!
OK! "
